meta.source: Concept A "Tavern Table" boards (A-Desktop / A-Phone, 2026-11-02) and the frontend-redesign foundations spec; current names from packages/ui-tokens/src/tokens.ts kept as aliases.
meta.aliasesForEngineers: surface-0..3, text-1..3, accent, accent-strong, accent-contrast, border-1, danger, success, warning, overlay, space-1..6, radius-s/m/l, duration-s/m keep their old names; map 1:1 into packages/ui-tokens.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The table: page background under everything. Oak in tavern, vellum desk in scroll, flat near-black in plain. Text on it uses text-on-ground.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Alias of ground for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Parchment leaf: every panel that carries body text (sheet sections, pickers, dialogs, tooltips, drawers). Ink on it is text-1/2/3.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Alias of leaf for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: leaf-glow
tokens.usage: Centre stop of the leaf's radial paper gradient (leaf-glow 0% to leaf 55% to leaf-dark 100%). Same ink rules as leaf.

tokens.name: leaf-dark
tokens.usage: Outer stop of the leaf gradient; the darkened paper edge. text-1/2/3 still pass on it.

tokens.name: leaf-sunken
tokens.usage: A recessed block inside a leaf (resource block, picker description, stepper rows). Ink text-1/2/3.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Alias of leaf-sunken for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: leaf-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline that edges a leaf (inset 1px), table rules inside leaves, chip borders. In plain it is a true 3:1 border.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Alias of leaf-edge for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Alias of leaf-edge for the existing ui-tokens name: the default hairline on parchment.

tokens.name: leather
tokens.usage: Leather base: folio, straps, action strap, satchel body, tab bar, dark buttons. Text on it: text-on-leather, text-on-leather-2.

tokens.name: leather-highlight
tokens.usage: Top stop of leather gradients (leather-highlight to leather to leather-dark) and the raised leather button top.

tokens.name: leather-dark
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of leather gradients; the dark chip on parchment (chip-dark). Text on it: text-on-leather-2.

tokens.name: leather-light
tokens.usage: Leather highlights: the satchel flap, folded edges, worn creases. Never behind text.

tokens.name: leather-edge
tokens.usage: Folio spine, satchel seam, the dark side of a leather fold; portrait well.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Sunken plate on leather for vitals (initiative, speed, saves): gradient plate to plate-bottom with inset shadow. Text: text-on-leather, labels text-on-leather-2.

tokens.name: plate-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the vitals plate gradient.

tokens.name: slot
tokens.usage: Satchel slot face (gradient slot to slot-bottom). Captions on it: text-on-leather, sub-captions text-on-leather-3; rarity rims rarity-*.

tokens.name: slot-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the slot face gradient.

tokens.name: recess
tokens.usage: The deepest dark: gauge tracks, the satchel floor behind the slot grid, number-field wells. Text in a well: text-on-leather.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, drawers and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Ink: primary text on leaf, leaf-glow, leaf-dark, leaf-sunken, chip-bg, tooltips.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink on leaf, leaf-sunken and leaf-dark: table headers, hints (italic), units.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary ink on leaf and leaf-sunken: placeholders, timestamps, disabled-with-reason copy. Passes 4.5:1 on leaf; keep it off leaf-dark.

tokens.name: text-on-leather
tokens.usage: Primary text on leather, leather-highlight, leather-dark, plate, slot and recess: values, names, big numerals.

tokens.name: text-on-leather-2
tokens.usage: Gold labels on leather and plate: vital labels, strap captions, folio sub-lines, the dark chip's text.

tokens.name: text-on-leather-3
tokens.usage: Muted text on slot and recess: satchel sub-captions (weight, rarity word, charges).

tokens.name: text-on-ground
tokens.usage: Text that sits directly on ground (page titles outside leaves, empty states).

tokens.name: text-on-ground-2
tokens.usage: Muted labels directly on ground.

tokens.name: text-on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brass fills (brass buttons, name plate, qty plates, active tab). Checked on brass and brass-top; brass-mid is the 3:1 lower edge of a gradient, never behind a whole label.

tokens.name: accent-contrast
tokens.usage: Alias of text-on-brass for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: text-on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on ember / danger fills (Damage button, remove buttons).

tokens.name: text-on-moss
tokens.usage: Text on moss / success fills (Heal button).

tokens.name: text-on-arcane
tokens.usage: Text on arcane fills (concentration ribbon, concentrating chip).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and brass-coloured text on leaf (Edit links in the review list). 4.5:1 on leaf and leaf-sunken.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active link ink on leaf.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass: rails, button fills, frames, rivet heads, icons on leather, proficiency dots, gauge fills for pools. Never text on leaf (use link or accent-strong).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of brass for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: brass-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of brass gradients (brass-top 0%, brass 45%, brass-mid 80%, brass-bottom 100%); highlight icons on leather; the active tab glow. Flat (equal to brass) in plain.

tokens.name: accent-light
tokens.usage: Alias of brass-top.

tokens.name: brass-mid
tokens.usage: Third stop of brass gradients; the darker stripe of the temp-HP hatch.

tokens.name: brass-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of brass gradients and the shadowed edge of rails. In plain it equals brass so every brass fill is flat.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Dark brass on parchment: leaf-title icons, chip icons, the ghost button's dashed border, dividers. 3:1 on leaf as an icon or border; for brass-coloured TEXT on leaf use link.

tokens.name: brass-shadow
tokens.usage: Inner ring of brass icon buttons and the HP buckle; the dark line under a brass rail.

tokens.name: rivet-light
tokens.usage: Rivet highlight stop. Transparent in plain, so rivet rows vanish with the ornaments.

tokens.name: rivet
tokens.usage: Rivet body stop. Transparent in plain.

tokens.name: rivet-dark
tokens.usage: Rivet shadow stop. Transparent in plain.

tokens.name: border-brass
tokens.usage: Brass hairline on leather (inset 1px around straps, plates, slots). Solid brass in plain so controls are bordered at 3:1.

tokens.name: stitch
tokens.usage: Dashed stitching inset on leather (outline 1px dashed, offset -5px to -8px). Transparent in plain.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Ember: HP gauge fill, the Damage button body (gradient ember to ember-bottom, ember-top only as the 1px top highlight), destructive actions, failure marks. Text on it: text-on-ember. Never text on leaf (use danger-strong).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Alias of ember for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: hp
tokens.usage: Alias of ember: the current-HP segment of HpGauge and PartyCard.

tokens.name: ember-top
tokens.usage: HP gauge highlight stop (ember-top, ember 55%, ember-bottom) and the 1px top bevel of the Damage button; never behind text (3.5:1). Flat in plain.

tokens.name: ember-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of ember gradients; the remove (x) disc behind a cross icon.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Ember as TEXT or icon on leaf and on danger-soft: condition chip text, error messages, the Stealth disadvantage note.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ember tint behind a condition chip or an error field on leaf; text on it is danger-strong.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Hairline of a condition chip / error field.

tokens.name: danger-on-leather
tokens.usage: Ember as text on leather (disadvantage note in the folio skills list, failure count on a strap).

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Moss: death-save success ring, healing marks and pool fills (3:1 marks). The Heal button body is moss-mid to moss-bottom with moss-top as its 1px highlight, so text-on-moss sits on moss-mid. Never text on leaf (use success-strong).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Alias of moss for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: heal
tokens.usage: Alias of moss: the heal control and heal numbers.

tokens.name: moss-top
tokens.usage: Heal button 1px top bevel and pool-fill highlight; never behind text. Flat in plain.

tokens.name: moss-mid
tokens.usage: Heal button body (moss-mid 0-55%, moss-bottom 100%): the band text-on-moss sits on, 4.5:1.

tokens.name: moss-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of moss gradients.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Moss as TEXT or icon on leaf and on success-soft: 'Saved' notes, heal amounts in the log.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Moss tint behind a success chip or toast body on leaf; text on it is success-strong.

tokens.name: arcane
tokens.usage: Arcane violet: the concentration ribbon, attunement gem body, spell-school marks, magic fills. Text on it: text-on-arcane. Never text on leaf (use arcane-strong).

tokens.name: magic
tokens.usage: Alias of arcane for magic effects and item charges.

tokens.name: concentration
tokens.usage: Alias of arcane: the concentration orb glyph (concentration-orb) and its ribbon.

tokens.name: slot-arcane
tokens.usage: Alias of arcane for spell-slot accents (the level numeral's ribbon on a seal row). The seals themselves are wax.

tokens.name: arcane-strong
tokens.usage: Arcane as TEXT or icon on leaf and on arcane-soft; also the concentrating chip's fill (with text-on-arcane).

tokens.name: arcane-light
tokens.usage: Arcane on leather: the concentration note on the action strap, the gem's highlight. 4.5:1 on leather.

tokens.name: arcane-soft
tokens.usage: Arcane tint behind a magic chip on leaf; text on it is arcane-strong.

tokens.name: arcane-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the gem gradient and the ribbon's shadowed fold.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning as text or icon on leaf (missing-pack banner, over-encumbered weight). Pairs with warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint behind a banner body on leaf; text on it is warning or text-1.

tokens.name: wax
tokens.usage: Wax seal body (middle stop of the seal's radial gradient wax-light, wax, wax-dark). Filled = available.

tokens.name: wax-light
tokens.usage: Seal gradient highlight stop. Flat in plain.

tokens.name: wax-dark
tokens.usage: Seal gradient outer stop.

tokens.name: wax-rim
tokens.usage: The stamped inner disc of a filled seal (the ground the embossed glyph or numeral sits on).

tokens.name: wax-rim-dark
tokens.usage: Stroke around the stamped disc.

tokens.name: wax-rim-light
tokens.usage: Offset highlight stroke on the stamped disc. Flat in plain.

tokens.name: wax-sheen
tokens.usage: Thin outline sheen on the wax blob and the pale specular ellipse's base.

tokens.name: wax-ink
tokens.usage: Emboss shadow of the glyph or numeral on a filled seal (offset +0.8px).

tokens.name: wax-emboss
tokens.usage: The embossed numeral/glyph on a filled seal; 24px glyphs, 3:1 on wax-rim.

tokens.name: wax-glyph
tokens.usage: Middle fill of a three-layer embossed glyph (ink, highlight wax-sheen, body wax-glyph) on small seals.

tokens.name: wax-spent
tokens.usage: Spent seal body (cooled pale wax): middle stop of wax-spent-light, wax-spent, wax-spent-dark.

tokens.name: wax-spent-light
tokens.usage: Spent seal highlight stop.

tokens.name: wax-spent-dark
tokens.usage: Spent seal outer stop.

tokens.name: wax-spent-rim
tokens.usage: Stroke of the spent seal's inner disc; 3:1 against leaf in plain.

tokens.name: wax-spent-inner
tokens.usage: Spent seal inner disc fill (the ground of its faint glyph or numeral).

tokens.name: wax-spent-dash
tokens.usage: Dashed inner ring of a spent seal.

tokens.name: wax-spent-ink
tokens.usage: Numeral on a spent seal (Forum 18-23px, 3:1+ on wax-spent-inner); the faint glyph uses wax-spent-dash.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral chip on leaf (tags, filter chips, campaign chip). Ink text-1, border chip-border.

tokens.name: chip-border
tokens.usage: Hairline of a neutral chip.

tokens.name: chip-dark
tokens.usage: Dark chip on leaf or leather (equipped, weight class); text text-on-leather-2, border border-brass.

tokens.name: coin-platinum
tokens.usage: Platinum coin face (CoinPouch disc, pp badge). Pairs with coin-platinum-shade.

tokens.name: coin-platinum-shade
tokens.usage: Platinum coin edge / lower discs of the stack.

tokens.name: coin-gold
tokens.usage: Gold coin face (gp).

tokens.name: coin-gold-shade
tokens.usage: Gold coin edge.

tokens.name: coin-silver
tokens.usage: Silver coin face (sp).

tokens.name: coin-silver-shade
tokens.usage: Silver coin edge.

tokens.name: coin-copper
tokens.usage: Copper coin face (cp).

tokens.name: coin-copper-shade
tokens.usage: Copper coin edge.

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Common rarity rim on a satchel slot (2px inset ring on slot). UI mark only, 3:1 on slot; the rarity word is always written in the sub-caption too.

tokens.name: rarity-uncommon
tokens.usage: Uncommon rarity rim on slot. UI mark only.

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Rare rarity rim on slot. UI mark only.

tokens.name: rarity-very-rare
tokens.usage: Very rare rarity rim on slot. UI mark only.

tokens.name: rarity-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary rarity rim on slot. UI mark only.

tokens.name: damage-acid
tokens.usage: Acid: damage tag ink and spell-school dot on leaf and leaf-sunken (the tag chip is leaf-sunken, never chip-bg). Always beside the word; 4.5:1.

tokens.name: damage-bludgeoning
tokens.usage: Bludgeoning damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-cold
tokens.usage: Cold damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-fire
tokens.usage: Fire damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-force
tokens.usage: Force damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-lightning
tokens.usage: Lightning damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-necrotic
tokens.usage: Necrotic damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-piercing
tokens.usage: Piercing damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-poison
tokens.usage: Poison damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-psychic
tokens.usage: Psychic damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-radiant
tokens.usage: Radiant damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-slashing
tokens.usage: Slashing damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: damage-thunder
tokens.usage: Thunder damage tag ink on leaf.

tokens.name: class-barbarian
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only (off by default): tints the barbarian class icon on leaf at 3:1.

tokens.name: class-bard
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: bard icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-cleric
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: cleric icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-druid
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: druid icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-fighter
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: fighter icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-monk
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: monk icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-paladin
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: paladin icon on leaf (dark brass).

tokens.name: class-ranger
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: ranger icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-rogue
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: rogue icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-sorcerer
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: sorcerer icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-warlock
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: warlock icon on leaf.

tokens.name: class-wizard
tokens.usage: Class tint, tokens only: wizard icon on leaf.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Inner 2px of the focus ring (shadow-focus): pale brass, 3:1+ on leather, plate, slot and tavern ground, and 3:1+ against focus-ring-outer itself, so the two-tone ring reads on brass and on scroll vellum too.

tokens.name: focus-ring-outer
tokens.usage: Outer 2px of the focus ring: dark brass, 3:1+ on leaf, leaf-sunken and chip-bg. The two rings together pass on every surface.

tokens.name: texture-wood-tint
tokens.usage: Ink of the wood-grain noise on ground (alpha = texture intensity: 0.5 tavern, 0.2 scroll, 0 plain). Apply through the feTurbulence filter 'hk-wood'.

tokens.name: texture-parchment-tint
tokens.usage: Ink of the paper grain on leaf (alpha 0.075 tavern, 0.06 scroll, 0 plain). Never more: body text sits on it.

tokens.name: texture-leather-tint
tokens.usage: Ink of the leather grain on leather, straps and the satchel (alpha 0.32; 0 in plain).

tokens.name: vignette-tint
tokens.usage: Candle vignette: a radial gradient from this colour at the top-right of ground to transparent (62% x 58% ellipse at 88% -4%). 0 in plain.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name on the home Continue leaf and the sheet's phone header at 390px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Screen titles (campaign name, wizard step title on desktop).

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Wordmark on the rail, dialog titles, name plate.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Leaf titles, satchel title, stepper step names.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The biggest glyphs on the board: current HP on the desktop folio. font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: AC inside the shield badge, HP on the phone strap. Tabular.

styles.name: numeral-m
styles.usage: To-hit and damage numerals in AttackRow, ability modifiers inside seals, vital values. Tabular.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hover a glyph to read what it means.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, descriptions in drawers, phone list rows. The phone's floor.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Desktop row text, table headers, chips, tooltips. The desktop floor.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Phone tab-bar labels and save-seal abbreviations only; never running text.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: The second line of a tooltip or a badge sub-label. Italic. Never the only copy of a meaning.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab labels; phone buttons take 16px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a seal and its label, chip inner gap, rivet inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a leaf, between chips, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a leaf; folio inner gap; phone leaf padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Leaf padding (16px 18px on desktop), dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between leaves on the table; rail horizontal padding (22px rounds here).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap on long screens; cover text block inset.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top-of-screen breathing room above the first leaf on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical rhythm; the page's reserved strap height on phone (54 + rivets).

tokens.name: radius-seal
tokens.usage: Pills: buttons, icon buttons, seals, gauges, proficiency dots.

tokens.name: radius-leaf
tokens.usage: Parchment leaves, chips (3-4px on tiny chips rounds to this), tooltips, number wells. (The concept drew leaves at 2px; the system settles on 6px.)

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-leaf for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: radius-slot
tokens.usage: Satchel slots, phone action buttons, the active tab glow.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Brass portrait frame, dialogs, picker cards, the folio's outer corners.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-frame for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: radius-strap
tokens.usage: Straps and the satchel's upper corners; bottom sheets' top corners.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-strap for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: shadow-leaf
tokens.usage: A parchment leaf lying on the table: warm paper shadow down-right plus the edge hairline. Flat 1px border in plain.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Leather objects that stand above the table: folio, satchel, dialogs, drawers, the top rail.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-slot
tokens.usage: Recessed leather: satchel slots, vitals plates, number wells, gauge tracks (gauge adds the 2px top shade).

tokens.name: shadow-brass
tokens.usage: The bevel on every brass fill: buttons, plates, name plate, portrait frame, active tab.

tokens.name: shadow-strap
tokens.usage: Leather straps (HP strap, weight strap, action strap) and leather buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, toasts and popovers: a small parchment slip.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on :focus-visible, every control: pale inner ring (reads on leather) + dark outer ring (reads on leaf). Never outline alone.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-brass
tokens.usage: Selected state glow: the active nav button, selected satchel slot, selected picker card.

decoration.note: Ornament intensities. The page can only hold one value per family, so these describe the tavern theme; the per-theme carriers are the colour tokens texture-*-tint, vignette-tint, rivet-*, stitch (alpha 0 in plain). Engineers: mirror these as per-theme numbers in ui-tokens.

tokens.name: texture-wood
tokens.usage: Wood grain on ground: 1 tavern, 0.4 scroll, 0 plain. feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.0022 0.055, 5 octaves, seed 9.

tokens.name: texture-parchment
tokens.usage: Paper grain on leaves: 1 tavern, 0.8 scroll, 0 plain. fractalNoise 0.85, 2 octaves, seed 3. Luminance variation under text stays below 8%.

tokens.name: texture-leather
tokens.usage: Leather grain: 1 tavern, 1 scroll, 0 plain. fractalNoise 0.55, 3 octaves, seed 5.

tokens.name: ornament-level
tokens.usage: 0 = no rivets, stitches, tilt or vignette (plain); 1 = hairlines and frames only (scroll keeps 2); 2 = full (tavern).

tokens.name: leaf-tilt
tokens.usage: Leaves rotate by ±0.2 to ±0.35deg, alternating sign down a column; 0 when ornament-level is 0 or reduced motion is on.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback, tooltip fade.

tokens.name: duration-s
tokens.usage: Alias of duration-fast for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Drawers, sheets, tab switches, seal spend.

tokens.name: duration-m
tokens.usage: Alias of duration-base for the existing ui-tokens name.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Damage shake, level-up flourish; all three collapse to 0 under reduced motion or the user's motion toggle.

tokens.name: hint-delay-hover
tokens.usage: Tooltip delay on hover/focus.

tokens.name: hint-delay-touch
tokens.usage: Long-press delay before the hint shows on touch.

tokens.name: control-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop button and tab height (36px hit area through a -4px ::before inset).

tokens.name: control-phone
tokens.usage: Phone button, ring and remove-button size; the touch floor.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch, 36px on desktop pointers.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Round brass icon button on rails and straps (44px on phone).

tokens.name: icon-button-s
tokens.usage: Small round icon button inside rows (details, remove).

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Minimum row height in compact density (skills, spells).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Minimum row height in comfortable density.

tokens.name: rail-height
tokens.usage: Top brass rail height on desktop and tablet.

tokens.name: strap-height
tokens.usage: Action strap height on desktop (9px rivets + 6px pad + 40px controls + 6px + 9px); the page reserves it.

tokens.name: tab-bar-height
tokens.usage: Phone leather tab bar height.
